title: Leche Flan
description: SAMASA, the Samahang Manggagawa ng Sampong, offered leche flan at Sibale’s December 2025 KADIWA events, according to the Department of Agriculture.
detailText: A locally documented sweet treat. Ask local producers about present availability; the report does not establish a current shop menu or price.

sources.title: Department of Agriculture–SAAD · Sibale KADIWA report · 29 December 2025

title: Coco Jam
description: The Kaagapay Organization sold coco jam among its value-added products at KADIWA in Concepcion, Romblon, as documented in the December 2025 agriculture report.
detailText: Coconut jam is a shared Filipino food, with local production documented in Sibale. Confirm the producer’s ingredients, packaging and current supply directly.

title: Atchara
description: Atchara was another processed product marketed by the Kaagapay Organization in Sibale’s December 2025 KADIWA events, according to DA-SAAD.
detailText: This Filipino pickle is documented in the island’s local food trade. Preparation and ingredients vary by producer; ask about current availability when visiting.
